groud_truth: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC BD : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b c BC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ (c.opposingSides d AB) ∧ (∠ a:b:c + ∠ a:b:d) = ∟ + ∟ → BC = BD
